invented.quote: The supply boat stops coming in December.
invented.why: The brief does not mention a supply boat or the month of December.

invented.quote: Together you ration what's in the stores, keep the lamp burning through storms, and look after each other when the cold and the quiet start to take their toll.
invented.why: The brief only states that players see a lighthouse keeper's family through a winter, without giving these specific gameplay actions or details.

invented.quote: I've spent three years making sure this game works before asking anyone to pay for it.
invented.why: The brief states that playtesting has run since 2023, not that the creator has spent three years making sure the game works.
The brief only says the game was playtested with about 60 different people and gives no information about who those people were.

invented.quote: where strangers sat down, played and told me what they thought
invented.why: The brief says the creator took the game to two conventions and got ratings from people who played at the table, not that those players were strangers who gave feedback.

invented.quote: Every one of those sessions changed something. The game you're backing has been reworked again and again, based on what happened when real people played it.
invented.why: The brief does not state that every playtest session led to changes or that the game was repeatedly reworked.

invented.quote: I've built this game in the evenings and on weekends.
invented.why: The brief says the creator works full time as a land surveyor, not that the game was built in the evenings and on weekends.

invented.quote: plus a small buffer for the surprises every first-time creator is warned about
invented.why: Neither the brief nor the additional background mentions that the funding goal includes a financial buffer for surprises.

invented.quote: Crowdfunding is the only way this game gets printed.
invented.why: The brief does not say that crowdfunding is the only way the creator can get the game printed.
